newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel new fire equipment to cost 20 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel new fire equipment to cost 20 mln stg.

text.p: Channel tunnel operator Eurotunnel SA /Plc said on Thursday it expects the cost of new fire hydrants and stations to be installed in the tunnel as part of a package of new safety measures to cost about 20 million stg ($33 million).
French co-chairman Patrick Ponsolle estimated the capital costs at a news conference at the Calais tunnel terminal. ($ = 0.609 British Pounds Sterling)
Ponselle added that the cost of training and extra staffing as part of the new safety measures would cost between one and 1.5 million stg in additional operating expenses a year.
